source: FOMOENGINE manual 0.1.0, verified 2026-07-10; copied for local sitting
thesis: One loop converts fear-of-missing-out into engagement. Countermeasures target the loop.

stages.name: Signal
stages.mechanism: Scarcity/novelty cue so inaction registers as loss
stages.countermeasure: Treat all urgency as fake until shown otherwise.

stages.name: Proof
stages.countermeasure: Decide before you look at the counter.

stages.name: Cascade
stages.mechanism: Copying without reasons; judgment outsourced to the crowd
stages.countermeasure: Ask: herd or cascade? Can adopters give reasons that aren't crowd size?

stages.name: Amplify
stages.mechanism: Recommenders feed the cascade; momentum can be seeded
stages.countermeasure: Do not manufacture attention. Chronological over ranked.

stages.name: Money
stages.mechanism: Capital herds: failing with the crowd is survivable
stages.countermeasure: Write the memo before checking who's in the round.

stages.name: Validate
stages.mechanism: Record numbers become headlines; skeptics ridiculed
stages.countermeasure: Read record-numbers headlines as stage-6 output, not evidence.

flip.name: The Flip
flip.mechanism: Cascades reverse faster than fundamentals change
flip.countermeasure: Expect the flip. Reversal is structural, date unknown.
